title: Missed Clue and Retcon Watch
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session
| stats sum(missed_clues) as missed_clues, sum(retcon_events) as retcons, count as sessions by campaign
| eval miss_rate=round(missed_clues/sessions,2)
| sort - retcons
description: Surfaces campaigns where missed clues or later retcons are piling up and story comprehension is drifting.
value: When missed clues accumulate, plots feel unfair; a retcon watch helps a GM rebalance how information is delivered.
implementation: Track missed clue counts and retcon events per session; summarize totals and rate by campaign.
visualization: Table of campaigns with missed clue rate and retcon count.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces when important clues keep getting lost and the story needs patching afterward.
